confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'there is no further owner-safe check that will fix this. You will need to replace the battery pack.'

rationale: The assistant reached the likely correct diagnosis (worn battery pack, SV12 model established) and told the customer to order a compatible pack. However, it asked for a 3.5h charge the customer had not yet reported doing, so the second turn repeated a step already completed, and it never asked about the months of declining runtime. It also gave the final answer with fairly firm certainty and did not recommend contacting Dyson support before buying, although it did mention Dyson only as a fallback if the new battery fails. It also never addressed the customer's warranty/cost concern, and its first-turn charging-light description (green/amber) was inaccurate for a Dyson.
